proof_body:
by
  intro X _ T K a x n hK0 hK1 h ha
  have hpos : 0 < 1 - K := by linarith
  have h1 : dist x a ≤ dist x (T x) / (1 - K) := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hpos]
    have t := dist_triangle x (T x) a
    have h2 := h x a
    rw [ha] at h2
    linarith
  have h2 : ∀ m : ℕ, dist (T^[m] x) a ≤ K ^ m * dist x a := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => simp
    | succ m ih =>
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']
      have h3 := h (T^[m] x) a
      rw [ha] at h3
      have h4 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih hK0
      rw [pow_succ]
      nlinarith
  have h3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (pow_nonneg hK0 n)
  have e : K ^ n * (dist x (T x) / (1 - K)) = K ^ n / (1 - K) * dist x (T x) := by ring
  linarith [h2 n]
target_source: ∀ (X : Type*) [MetricSpace X] (T : X → X) (K : ℝ) (a x : X) (n : ℕ), 0 ≤ K → K < 1 → (∀ u v, dist (T u) (T v) ≤ K * dist u v) → T a = a → dist (T^[n] x) a ≤ K ^ n / (1 - K) * dist x (T x)
